name: Really Real Bots (3.10.5 SAIN Preset)
teaser: 3.10.5 SAIN Preset designed to work well with Fontaine's Realism Mod paired with TarkovIRL.
description_html:
NOTE: I’ve moved on to SPT 3.11.3 so I no longer have the motivation to continue updating this preset for 3.10. However the developer of IRL Tarkov has made his own improved version of it. Check it out here

Thought I’d share this WIP SAIN preset I’ve been tinkering with on 3.10 with the Realism Mod. The goal is to get bots that will be challenging but fair.

Realistic Combat Overhaul by Tritantrfl7 was used as a template for this preset.

Notes:

- Best used with Realism Mod and TarkovIRL as the preset is configured with these in mind

- Tarkov Weather System and Immersive Daylight Cycle recommended for extra immersion

- Configured with That’s Lit installed

Key Differences from RCO Preset:

- Bot stats are scaled per difficulty level to allow for some randomness

- Bot aiming precision adjusted to reflect TarkovIRL handling

- Bots will struggle more to see you in poor weather conditions (goes well with TWS)

- General difficulty sliders are set to default to allow for simple difficulty tweaks

I’m open to suggestions on how to possibly improve this preset further as alot of testing is usually required to get bot configs just right.
